note: changes on dev since the last release, in the changelog.json item shape; scripts/release-notes.ts --apply moves them into apps/site/public/landing/releases/changelog.json at release time

items.text: Routine script output keeps characters split across reads (like the euro sign, Hindi or emoji) in its report and error message.
When ChatGPT refuses a model for Codex, the turn quietly runs again on Codex's default model instead of showing Try again.
Codex's failed replies about a refused model now say to change the model, not to try again.
A dusk cloud keeps its Codex CLI up to date by itself, taking a new Codex release once it has been out for 48 hours.
The working line says what the bot is doing first, and shows a step like searching right away instead of Thinking.
A message sent, posted or saved through an app found by tool search now counts as done, so the reply can say so.
Every release now ships the server and CLI package (duskbot-<version>.tgz) and the newest Android APK on GitHub, and lists everything it changed on dusk.bot/changelog.
duskbot update tells you when a newer server is out, shows what changed and updates it the right way for how you installed it.
